summary: Phase 1.5 bus-protocol hardening: fixed all Codex-verified Phase-1 bugs and proved each with an adversarial Verilator testbench. W-before-AW deadlock (axil_1to2/npu_top: hold W until route known), WSTRB byte-merge (CSR+TCM), 3-way decode CSR/TCM/DECERR (axil_decerr.v: out-of-window -> SLVERR), TCM out-of-range SLVERR, DMA LEN=0 no-op, DMA RRESP -> STATUS.dma_err. Sim engine = Verilator (--binary --timing); VCS = signoff OUTSIDE-SANDBOX; iverilog no longer used. 15/15 gate tests green.
note: Frozen IP/cpu_m1/rtl/ untouched. Phase 1 now genuinely bus-protocol-correct (not just happy-path). Deferred: double-buffer/multi-outstanding, DMA DST-overflow guard, formal AXI check. Next = Phase 2 stripped-cpu_m1 NPU scalar.
